Full Figma URL to extract file_key, node_id, and team_id from. Works with any Figma URL format:

• Design: https://www.figma.com/design/ABC123/Design-Name
• Board: https://www.figma.com/board/ABC123/Board-Name
• Prototype: https://www.figma.com/proto/ABC123/Prototype-Name
• Slides: https://www.figma.com/slides/ABC123/Slide-Name

REQUIRED PARAMETERS: - file_key (string): The Figma file key from the URL - images (array): List of objects, each containing: - node_id (string, required): The node ID to export (e.g., "1:2") - file_name (string, required): Output filename with extension (e.g., "logo.png") - format (string, optional): One of 'png', 'svg', 'jpg', 'pdf'. Defaults to 'png' Example usage: { "file_key": "abc123XYZ", "images": [ {"node_id": "1:2", "file_name": "logo.png", "format": "png"} ] } To find node IDs, use figma.get_file_json or look in Figma URLs after 'node-id='. NOTE: Returned image URLs expire shortly after generation — download them immediately.

file_name.title: File Name
file_name.description: REQUIRED. The output filename with extension for the downloaded image (e.g., 'logo.png', 'header-image.svg', 'icon.jpg').

tools.name: render_images_of_file_nodes
tools.description: Render Figma nodes as images (PNG, JPG, SVG, PDF). Returns a map of node IDs to temporary image URLs (valid for 30 days). Images are capped at 32 megapixels; larger requests are automatically scaled down. REQUIRED PARAMETERS: - file_key: Figma file key from URL (e.g., 'abc123XYZ' from figma.com/design/abc123XYZ/...) - ids: Comma-separated node IDs to render (e.g., '1:2' or '1:2,1:3,1:4') NODE IDs: Found in Figma URLs after 'node-id=' or from figma.get_file_json response. FORMATS: - png/jpg: Raster images with optional scale (0.01-4.0) - svg: Vector graphics with text outline options - pdf: Document format COMMON ISSUES: - null value in images map = node failed to render (invalid ID, invisible, 0% opacity) - 404 error = file_key not found or no access - 429 error = rate limit exceeded, wait and retry

input_schema.title: RenderImagesOfFileNodesRequest

ids.title: Ids
ids.description: Comma-separated list of node IDs to render as images. Node IDs are found in Figma URLs after 'node-id=' (e.g., '1:2') or from figma.get_file_json response. Example: '1:2,1:3,1:4'.

scale.title: Scale
scale.description: Image scaling factor between 0.01 and 4.0. Example: 2.0 renders at 2x resolution. Applies to PNG/JPG only; ignored for SVG/PDF.

version.title: Version
version.description: Specific version ID of the file to render. If omitted, uses current version.

file_key.title: File Key
file_key.description: Key of the Figma file or branch. Extract from Figma URLs: figma.com/design/{file_key}/... or figma.com/file/{file_key}/... For branch keys, use GET /v1/files/:key with branch_data=true.

contents_only.title: Contents Only
contents_only.description: If true, excludes content that overlaps node boundaries. If false, includes overlapping content (may increase processing time).

svg_include_id.title: Svg Include Id
svg_include_id.description: (SVG only) If true, includes 'id' attributes (using layer names) on SVG elements.

svg_outline_text.title: Svg Outline Text
svg_outline_text.description: (SVG only) If true, text renders as vector paths (outlines) for exact visual fidelity. If false, text renders as <text> elements (selectable, but appearance may vary by system fonts).

svg_include_node_id.title: Svg Include Node Id
svg_include_node_id.description: (SVG only) If true, adds 'data-node-id' attribute (with Figma node ID) to SVG elements.

svg_simplify_stroke.title: Svg Simplify Stroke
svg_simplify_stroke.description: (SVG only) If true, simplifies strokes using 'stroke' attribute instead of <mask>.

use_absolute_bounds.title: Use Absolute Bounds
use_absolute_bounds.description: If true, uses full node dimensions ignoring cropping/empty space. Useful for text nodes to avoid unintended cropping.
